id: title:Gilbert09:keep api keys out of credential probe errors

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse source credential validation and user-facing error messaging
review.reason: The chunk implements a localized improvement to warehouse source credential validation, specifically adding a helper function `unreachable_vendor_message` to return a user-friendly string when a warehouse API probe fails, rather than returning `None`. This is demonstrated in P1.F1.H1, P1.F2.H1, and P1.F2.H2. The change improves the user experience for PostHog warehouse source users
review.uncertainty: The chunk is explicitly identified as a subset of a larger change; it does not include the complete implementation of credential validation or the removal of NO_MESSAGE and LEAKS_SECRET dictionaries. Therefore, while the observed behavior is a clear, bounded improvement, the full scope and systemic impact of the parent change are not demonstrated. No tier 3 systemic benefit or tier

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the credential validation and the complete removal of the NO_MESSAGE and LEAKS_SECRET dictionaries, nor does it include the complete implementation of the OpenAlex and xMatters credential validation. observations.behavior: Adds a helper function unreachable_vendor_message to return a user-friendly message when a vendor probe fails to establish a connection, rather than returning None or an empty message.
observations.code_quote: return f"Couldn't reach {vendor} to check your credentials. Try again in a few minutes."
observations.posthog_connection: This could improve the user experience for PostHog warehouse source integrations by providing a clearer error message when a warehouse API is unreachable, rather than a generic or missing message.
